title: Concept: Short password minimum length (html) — review required
description: A length floor under eight (minlengths*=s*["']?[0-7]b) permits the weakest common passwords. Length is the cheapest password defense; the remedy is raising to 12+ characters.
applicability: html signup and credential forms; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessable user passwords; LOW severity (one control among several).
